title: RankedProduct
description: A WooCommerce product card as returned from the cloud, extended with AI ranking fields. All inferred fields carry source, confidence, updated_at and approval_state.

requires_options.description: True when add_to_cart.text === 'Select options' on the Store API. Drives the 'אפשרויות' button. Never infer from type/has_options/variations — the theme overrides only add_to_cart.text.

options_url.description: URL of the product page where WooCommerce renders the option chooser (= add_to_cart.url from Store API). Only meaningful when requires_options is true.

price_display.description: Authoritative price HTML string for display. ALWAYS use this, never prices.price (which is price-per-gram for weighted products and will show ₪0.19 instead of ₪37.80). Equals price_html from Store API.

weight_display.description: Human-readable weight label, e.g. '200 גרם'. Optional.

price_per_unit.description: Human-readable unit price, e.g. '₪18.90 / 100 גרם'. Optional, only for weighted products.

substitutes.description: AI-suggested substitutes when intent_type is substitute_request.

reason.description: Why this is a good substitute.

ai_rank.description: 1-based position in the AI-ranked result set.

ai_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this product was ranked here.

suggest_qty.description: Suggested quantity for the query context (e.g. servings × pack size). Never used to modify cart directly — only a UI hint.

approval_state.description: Allergen and origin fields must be approved before display. review_required is true when approval_state is pending.
